mapper.sql: reservation_id, space_id, storage_key, reserved_bytes, status, expire_time, retry_count, next_retry_time, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, last_error_code
mapper.select: select from drive_upload_reservation where reservation_id = #{reservationId} for update

select from drive_upload_reservation where (status = 'RESERVED' and expire_time <= #{now}) or (status = 'CLEANUP_FAILED' and next_retry_time <= #{now}) or (status = 'CLEANING' and update_time <= #{staleCleaningBefore}) order by coalesce(next_retry_time, expire_time), reservation_id limit #{limit}
select coalesce(sum(reserved_bytes), 0) from drive_upload_reservation where status in ('RESERVED', 'CLEANING', 'CLEANUP_FAILED')
select count(*) from drive_upload_reservation where (status = 'RESERVED' and expire_time <= #{now}) or (status = 'CLEANING' and update_time <= #{staleCleaningBefore})
select count(*) from drive_upload_reservation where status = 'CLEANUP_FAILED'
mapper.update: update drive_upload_reservation set status = 'CLEANUP_FAILED', retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, last_error_code = #{lastErrorCode}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where reservation_id = #{reservationId} and version = #{version} and status in ('RESERVED', 'CLEANING')
